section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the primary innovation of repentance is that it enables the subsequent service of Torah and mitzvos to be performed with greater power, thereby revealing higher levels of the soul and perfecting the world as a dwelling place for G-d.
section.t: And one may add,
that the primary innovation and superiority of the penitents is in the service of Torah and mitzvos that follows repentance,
for the service of repentance is to leap over the root
not in the order and manner of the chain of descent.
Therefore,
the revelation of the essential connection of the essence of the soul with the Awtsmoos, which comes about through repentance and atonement,
even though the revelation is in those levels in which the flaw occurred,
which generally are the aspects of Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah,
it is as if the Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah are in a manner of elevation upward
(to the levels of Chayah and Yechidah,
and even to the essence of the soul).
And the primary innovation and superiority of repentance is that through repentance,
even the service of Torah and mitzvos is with greater power.
For the service of Torah and mitzvos is in an ordered sequence
[since
(most)
mitzvos have a limited measure, as explained in Tanya,
and certainly the study of Torah, which is in understanding and comprehension],
and through the service of Torah and mitzvos after repentance being with greater power,
the revelation of Chayah and Yechidah
(and one could say also of the essence of the soul)
in the Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah is as if the Nefesh-Ruach-Neshamah are below.
And beyond this,
that through the service of Torah and mitzvos, the world also becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He,
and through this the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is completed,
as is known regarding the matter of "in whom He consulted, in the souls of the righteous,"
that this which they said "in the souls of the righteous"
(even though in the place where penitents stand, even completely righteous individuals cannot stand),
for the ultimate purpose of creation is that there be a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms,
and this is accomplished through the service of the righteous,
the service of Torah and mitzvos.
However, the perfection in the service of Torah and mitzvos is when it comes after the precedence of repentance, for then the service of Torah and mitzvos is with greater power,
and through this there is an addition in the revelation of G-dliness
(within man,
and through this)
also in the world,
and through this the intention of a dwelling place in the lower realms is more fully completed.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that despite the lofty level of repentance reaching to Hashem your G-d, one must still "take words with you" for verbal confession to eradicate the husks.
section.t: And this is "Return, O Israel, unto Hashem your G-d... take words with you,"
that which it adds "take words with you" after saying "Return, O Israel, unto Hashem your G-d,"
is,
because of the greatness of the elevation in the service of repentance,
and particularly in the repentance of "Return... unto Hashem your G-d,"
that the repentance is in the aspect of "unto" and not including,
and beyond this—"Hashem your G-d,"
through which the essence of the soul, which is connected with the Awtsmoos, is revealed
(which is above even the Master of Will),
and even though it is found in a most exalted level,
and seemingly is not relevant to the rectification of flaws
[and particularly that to rectify this one must descend from his level],
nevertheless it says "take words with you,"
that there must be verbal confession,
in order to eradicate the body of the husks.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section offers another interpretation of "take words with you" as Torah and mitzvos, which elevate the soul's levels as they are below and refine the world into a dwelling place for G-d.
section.t: And another interpretation of "take words with you,"
that "words" are Torah and mitzvos.
That even regarding the matter of rectifying sins,
although there is in this the advantage that through it the revelation of the essence of the soul is drawn down
(also)
into the lower levels in which flaw is relevant,
nevertheless,
even this is not sufficient,
and there must be "take words with you,"
Torah and mitzvos,
for through this there will be elevation also in the levels of the soul as they are below
(and not in a manner of elevation upward),
and beyond this,
that through this there is also clarification and refinement of the world,
and it becomes a dwelling place for Him, blessed be He, in the lower realms.
